stops.name: Roe Valley Country Park
stops.detail:
This picturesque and peaceful park on the outskirts of Limavady offers riverside woodland walks along the River Roe.

You can explore the area's cultural past and the historical remnants of the industry that once thrived there to harness the power of the river. Seasonal salmon and trout fishing is available under permit from the local angling club. There are picnic facilities and a café on-site.
